title: Question 21
passage:
We only checked for the leak with the pump off. Can I tell the client it’s fixed?
A. Not yet. Tell them we still need to test it with the pump running. B. Yes. Tell them we didn’t find a leak while the pump was running. C. Ask them whether they saw the leak before the repair.
passageZh:
我們只在泵浦停機時檢查過有沒有洩漏。我可以跟客戶說已經修好了嗎？
A. 還不能。告訴他們，我們還需要在泵浦運轉時再測一次。 B. 可以。告訴他們，我們在泵浦運轉時沒有發現洩漏。 C. 問他們修理前有沒有看到洩漏。
